title: Lie algebra is the cotangent dual at the rational identity
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $G$ a group scheme over $k$ [def-sc-group-scheme]. Put $e=e_G(\operatorname{Spec}k)$, $R=\mathcal O_{G,e}$, and $\kappa=\kappa(e)$ [def-weil-residue-field]. There exists a ring isomorphism $r:k\simeq\kappa$ and an $r$-semilinear equivalence from $\operatorname{Lie}(G)$ [def-wf-lie-algebra-derivation] to $\operatorname{Hom}_\kappa(\mathfrak m_R/\mathfrak m_R^2,\kappa)$, with the canonical residue-field scalar structure on the cotangent space [lem-sc-rational-tangent-cotangent-duality]. No smoothness or finite-type hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Dimension paragraph, identification of Lie algebra with tangent space at the identity; sk-i-cartier third paragraph; Stacks Project Tag 0B2C

proof.text: Use identityResidueEquiv G, defined as RingEquiv.ofBijective of the structural residue homomorphism using identity_residue_rational G. This is a ring isomorphism from k to the residue field at the same identity point.
Use the existing upstream construction lieIdentityTangentEquiv G to identify Lie G with the scheme tangent space as k-modules, with the same identity point and structural residue scalar action.

Apply exists_rationalPoint_tangent_cotangent_linearEquiv using residue rationality. Compose its chosen linear equivalence with lieIdentityTangentEquiv and cotangentDualScalarEquiv, transporting functional values by identityResidueEquiv. This is exactly the existing upstream lieCotangentDualEquiv construction. The old existential statement follows by introducing identityResidueEquiv G and this equivalence as witnesses, so the duplicate Sheaf module is withdrawn without removing the mathematics.

def lieCotangentDualEquiv {k : Type u} [Field k] (G : Over (Spec (.of k))) [GrpObj G] :
    let R := G.left.presheaf.stalk (unitSection G (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k))
    letI : RingHomInvPair (identityResidueEquiv G).toRingHom
        (identityResidueEquiv G).symm.toRingHom :=
      RingHomInvPair.of_ringEquiv (identityResidueEquiv G)
    letI : RingHomInvPair (identityResidueEquiv G).symm.toRingHom
        (identityResidueEquiv G).toRingHom :=
      RingHomInvPair.of_ringEquiv (identityResidueEquiv G).symm
    Lie G ≃ₛₗ[(identityResidueEquiv G).toRingHom]
      Module.Dual (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) (IsLocalRing.CotangentSpace R)
